correctness.rationale: The exact 0/1 polytope inequality representation is a published proposition. Every two-face arises by tight coordinate bounds and optional tail cap; slack cap gives exactly the three free-coordinate triangle classes, tight cap the head×tail square class or a triangle with a fixed tail. The classification is exhaustive and disjoint by nonconstant coordinate support, with exact binomial counts. Fixed-rank leading degrees, derivative sign, and two-stage large-rank expansion are reproduced in the proof. An independent-by-method exact face-lattice enumerator agrees in eight small cases, and 315 parameter checks verify binomial reductions; finite tests alone are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The local two-skeleton area distribution is a natural metric refinement of matroid face enumeration that generic f-vectors do not determine. The new exact formulas reveal a unique optimized head fraction for each rank and a rank-varying concentration phenomenon: optimally shaped high-rank panhandles have square two-faces with limiting frequency approaching one at sharp rate 4/(3 sqrt(r-1)). This is a motivated, nontrivial structural distribution and extremal law, not arbitrary small-dimensional arithmetic.
